study_metadata.title: Dual-Annotator Measured Human Evaluation Study
study_metadata.methodological_notes: Evaluates 30 distinct benchmark items with paired candidate outputs (Candidate A and Candidate B) scored by 2 independent reviewers (30 items x 2 candidates x 2 reviewers = 120 total review records). Includes offline prototype runs where deterministic fallback mock outputs were evaluated against the human rubric and penalized accordingly (e.g. score 2/5 for deficient mock text).
